orientation_group: D4 square action on rectangle masks plus Fano diagonal gauge action on the three intrinsic channels
orientation_quotient_statement: Every admissible Type-A tomotope orientation lands in the same Levi E4 sector after quotienting by D4 mask orientation and Fano channel relabeling.
reason: D4 moves the single exterior-edge hinge among the four co-singleton masks, while Fano relabeling permutes the three diagonal channel labels; BT713/BT717 show all 12 resulting sheets have rank 81.
boundary: This proves E4-sector uniqueness under the project admissibility class, not a theorem that Type-B sheets are impossible in every external convention.
